items.title: Ray Sherman interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 13, 1998
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] It’s almost the Mantovani of the 90s. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah. I’m hopeful it isn’t that bad yet.

ctx.x: me it gets monotonous after a while. It’s like we used to call “mood music.” And it’s just not interesting to me. I admire the performer, but just sit down for fun.
It’s almost the Mantovani of the 90s.
Yeah. I’m hopeful it isn’t that bad yet. And guys, what the heck, they’re making a good living at it.
